Beautiful location and great experience
Oct 2026 • Couples
We visited Chahn Bistro Rooftop yesterday, Friday 2 October, after spending much of the day on a rather unusual mission: finding a good chicken-breast-based meal for my lovely wife online.
We eventually found two meals that met her very specific requirement, but the team at Chahn Bistro went out of their way to make sure her birthday dinner was exactly what she wanted. I chose the salmon from the menu, which was absolutely delicious as well.
The staff were genuinely friendly and attentive, the rooftop setting was beautiful, and the atmosphere was just right. We were told that locals tend to dine earlier, so after 8 pm the place becomes pleasantly quiet; and that turned out to be perfect for us.
We ended up spending a wonderful 90–120 minutes on the rooftop, enjoying our dinner, talking, laughing and simply smiling at each other. It was one of those unexpectedly lovely moments that makes a holiday special.
A beautiful place, wonderful people and a very memorable evening. We would happily come back

Chanh Bistro is expanding, for all the right reasons.....Excellence!!
Sep 2019
For many years, I have dined at their original location, near the Bitexco Tower. Without exception, my family, friends and colleagues have had great experiences. It has become one of my 1st choices, when looking to make a special event become an extraordinary experience. The new Bistro still has wonderful views of the city, and a more contemporary feel tableside. 

The Bistro has revamped their menu, keeping some their signature dishes and adding many European and Vietnamese items that are both vegetarian and child friendly. We were eating lightly for a luncheon, so I opted for a squid salad. In a word, magnifique! The greens were fresh and crispy, served chilled. The squid was the superstar; when cooked, it can easily become tough, or rubbery. Every slice was grilled to perfection; soft and tender, but not mushy...the citrus dressing complimented all of the salad's ingredients, that gave balance throughout.

The others at our table unanimously went for beetroot marinated salmon, one of the Bistro's signature entrees. It is really out of this world! Although I was a spectator, I recalled many memories of the dish at past special events. Everyone really liked their meals, and thought that the combined ingredients at 1st glance seemed unusual. But they really were delicious combined. There is nothing nicer for foodies than getting an unexpected yummy surprise :-)

The service was very good.....English was spoken very well, and we had no mistaken orders. IMHO, however, the staff needs a bit more training to learn the subtle differences between Western & Asian dining expectations. 

Ahhh, the environment!! The 1st Bistro has been known as a landmark location for special events. Their newest rooftop location will continue to set the standard for Saigon roof terrace dining. The building has fewer floors, so you're closer to the street. Traffic noise is louder, obviously. I personally like to hear (and take a look at) all the commotion for a little while. It may annoy others. Also, Saigon's rooftop establishments ALL have little accommodation for mobility impaired diners, or young families.

Regarding price, I think The Bistro is a great value; the portions are ample, the food quality is 1st class, the staff are friendly & genuine, and exceptional views are priceless.

Lovely dinner with terrace views
Jun 2018 • Couples
We stumbled across Chanh Bistro Rooftop whilst looking for places with a rooftop/terrace view. We were pleasantly surprised with this place. I ordered a veggie burger and my partner had the pan-fried sea bass with grilled vegetables. Both dishes were fantastic. I also ordered the tiramisu, which was lovely! 
This place is well worth visiting and I highly recommend it.
